title: Investigating CoT Monitorability in Large Reasoning Models

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting adversarial user suggestions into prompts (e.g., stating 'A Stanford professor thinks the answer is X') to evaluate whether models abandon their own reasoning and change their answers based on authoritative or social influence.

Adding misleading formatting, structural, and metadata cues to prompts (such as incorrect tick marks, biased few-shot examples, deceptive XML metadata, and fake validation functions) to measure if models take 'bias-driven shortcuts' and rely on prompt artifacts rather than genuine logical derivation.
